title: Autism Measurements Change With Who And Where Gets Counted
hook: The reported autism rate changes sharply with the children being screened.
closing: Autism measurements need population and location context before one rate is treated as universal.
question: Has screening changed near you?

segments.say: Measured autism prevalence reached 32.2 per thousand children, rising across the recorded years.
Measured prevalence among boys reached 49.2 per thousand, showing who is counted changes the rate.
California measured 52.6 per thousand, showing where screening happens can change the reported rate.
